note: Models the setup script offers for claude-mnemonic's optional local LLM backend. 'status' is what we know from comparing them on real turns against Haiku (scripts/llm-eval, issue #26): no model is recommended for summaries or observations. Sizes are approximate downloads.

models.name: gemma3:12b
models.notes: Best local model on summaries, but not good enough to replace Haiku: judged faithful 3.9 against 4.9, about 6 in 10 summaries had an unsupported claim, and long conversations (the PreCompact case) fall to about 3.3.

models.name: granite3.3:8b
models.notes: About as good as gemma3:12b at half the size, faster, and Apache-2.0. Same limits: not good enough to replace Haiku for summaries.

models.name: llama3.1:8b
models.notes: Generic and often unfaithful even with a prompt written for small models. Not recommended.

models.name: llama3.2:3b
models.notes: Generic and sometimes wrong on real turns, and it can copy an example from the prompt on long input. Not recommended.
